messages.author: 9cc042d8ce376c1f
messages.subject: Does matrix modification happen "in place"?
parts: The docs claim that functions pass big objects by reference, so that things get modified "in place" with nimble more than in base R.  Does assignment also modify objects "in place"?  viz, if I create a `A <- matrix(nrow=2,ncol=2)` and set `A[1,1] <- 5`, is there still exactly one copy of a 2x2 matrix in memory, and there is an address `&A` that remains unchanged throughout this operation?

messages.subject: Re: Does matrix modification happen "in place"?
parts: Yes, but in compiled code only. In uncompiled code, you'll get base R behavior.
